nativeCapabilities.subagents: available in current local releases when requested or required by AGENTS.md/skills
nativeCapabilities.worktrees: Disabled for this project by user decision; use the existing main checkout.

dispatchGuidance: Read AGENTS.md and ortak/gelistirme-plani.md; develop directly on main.
Do not create branches, worktrees, PRs or per-item review/verify/integration gates.
Use code_pusher in the same checkout only for authorized Git commit/push operations.
Run tests and final review only after all planned features are implemented; fix defects and rerun the affected tests and final suite.
Historical orchestrator run/result/event files are not required for current development.
limitations: Subagents add token and startup cost.
Non-interactive work cannot satisfy a new approval prompt.
Project custom-agent authoring formats may evolve.
